pages.title: Neutron Interferometer
pages.text: A neutron's wave split by a perfect silicon crystal and joined again. Tilt it, and gravity pulls one path more than the other: quantum mechanics and gravity in one measurement.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 3$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

Choose the neutron wavelength and tilt the interferometer: gravity shifts the phase between the paths by Δφ = 2πm²gλA·sin α/h² (39.4 rad per Å here, upright). Land on a bright fringe with at least 30 rad of shift, and count long enough to fix the phase to 0.1 rad.

pages.text: Cycling blocks: any of them fits (Interface Ports, higher coil/emitter tiers). Rotate, zoom and view layers in $(thing)JEI$().
